title: Epictetus
idiom: classical ink portrait — woodcut-style, high contrast, hand-carved line quality
hero_prompt: Wide darkfield backdrop, deep shadow with warm lamplight catching a single seated figure in rough woven cloth, a man of slave origins turned teacher — not a portrait likeness, but the spirit of one who taught from chains: an open hand gesturing outward, a broken shackle on the wrist barely visible at the edge of light, scrolls curled at the feet, a small flame the only illumination against the dark. Woodcut print medium, hand-carved line quality, strong chiaroscuro, no letters, numerals, words, labels, or text of any kind — purely pictorial.
icon_prompt: Bold square emblem: a single open hand palm-up with a broken chain link resting in it, high contrast black on aged parchment, thick woodcut line weight, no fine detail, no letters, numerals, words, or labels — survives at 24px.
